evidence_quotes.O: I tested these with several pieces of film music (Emiliana Torrini's "Gollum's Song", John Murphy's "In the House In a Heartbeat" and Batman Begins)
evidence_quotes.C: Upgrading is a 15-minute process - 5 minutes to change the cards out, 5 minutes to register and download the drivers, and 5 minutes of software installation and rebooting.
evidence_quotes.E: Wow, what an experience! When they said "Crystal Clear", they really mean it - the sound definition is remarkable considering there's no sub-woofer.
evidence_quotes.A: If you're looking for a cheap but basic HD camcorder in the same price range, check out Panasonic's HM-TA1.
evidence_quotes.N: Falls frustratingly short for a Canon product: Canon seems to have taken a step down from the comparatively-excellent FS200 with a range of features that fall short in so many areas.
